title: Ann Demeulemeester Spring/Summer Pre-Collection 2027 - Fucking Young!
snippet: Paris Fashion Week's soaring temperatures made the arrival of Dries Van Noten's Spring/Summer 2027 collection feel especially timely. 26 Jun — Collection. Paris
extractedText: Ann Demeulemeester Spring/Summer Pre-Collection 2027 by Adriano Batista Share 25 Jun. Collection. Spring/Summer. Stefano Gallici approached this pre-collection differently. Rather than treating it as a standalone moment, he placed it within the same mindscape as the collection that will be presented in October, allowing both narratives to evolve in parallel and speak to each other. The starting point is travel and research. No single muse or historical period anchors the work. Instead, Gallici found himself drawn to garments and objects collected along the way, fragments of experiences and discoveries that gradually formed a personal landscape of references. These encounters opened the door to new directions. The idea of wardrobe still resonates, but the first signs of new obsessions are emerging. Familiar codes return: Hussar jackets, leather biker jackets, bohemian shirts. These are garments that continue to hold meaning, returning each time with a renewed sense of purpose. At the same time, the need to avoid repetition pushes forward. Tailoring becomes more structured, with slimmer proportions and subtle flared silhouettes. Aviator jackets are introduced, part of an ongoing exploration of outerwear. Fluid Edwardian-inspired slip dresses replace the Victorian sensibility of the past, landing a softer romance. The pre-collection is available now. Check it out below: Share 25 Jun. Collection. Spring/Summer.
